audit.why: Content states Yuumi favoured levels 1-3, Nautilus favoured level 4-5 onward (win rate 45.74%, packet levelChart Yuumi x3, Nautilus x4) — matches Dredge Line being a slow, dodgeable hook early that becomes an unpeelable chain once Depth Charge (R) is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-2].side say "Nautilus" and phases[3-6].side say "Skill", contradicting content win[] (Yuumi,Yuumi,Yuumi,Nautilus,Nautilus,Nautilus,Nautilus).
audit.why: The full layer flips levels 1-3 to Nautilus and leaves 4-6 neutral, when content (matching the packet) says the opposite for the early rows and Nautilus for the late ones.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-2].side to Yuumi and phases[3-6].side to Nautilus, with grounded why text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Dredge Line as matchup-defining with no cooldown number, and never states that Staggering Blow, Dredge Line, or Depth Charge cancel Yuumi's Final Chapter channel.
audit.why: Missing-interactions data flags your-channel-punished as applicable and unstated.
audit.corrected: Add the cooldown and the channel-cancel interaction.

edits.before: Poke from the saddle — the attached Q steers and the lane can't bill you for it.
edits.after: Dredge Line (Q, 14s cooldown at rank 1) is a slow-traveling hook you dodge by juking on your ADC — free Q poke while he's on cooldown.

edits.before: Dismount windows begin: the passive autos shield and heal; schedule them carefully.
edits.after: You punish every whiffed hook — 14s is a long cooldown that leaves him with no engage.

edits.before: Full rhythm: attach for the trades, dismount for the passive, never linger between.
edits.after: You still lead before his passive root and E slow chain come fully online.

edits.before: Zoomies the margins — the host's tempo is your tempo; bank the chip.
edits.after: Reliable hooks (down to 11-10s by now) plus his passive root and E slow start locking your ADC.

edits.before: Final Chapter online — the root waves referee every dive on your host.
edits.after: Depth Charge (R, 120/100/80s) is an unstoppable, unmissable knock-up you have zero peel for — hug turret once it's up.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the steered Qs chunk.
edits.after: His tank CC chain guarantees a kill off one landed hook; your R only heals through it.

edits.before: Late Yuumi is the unkillable second health bar: attach, amplify, and out-vote the focus fire.
edits.after: Two items deep his R-Q-E chain deletes your carry while you can only heal — stay glued and never let him reach your backline.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line (Hook): matchup-defining — His only real engage — dodge it and the lane is free. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W attach (untargetability) banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Nautilus Dredge Line (Hook, 14-10s cooldown): matchup-defining — his only real engage, dodge it and the lane is free. - Staggering Blow, Dredge Line and Depth Charge all cancel your Final Chapter channel — only cast R once his CC is spent. - Keep W attach (untargetability) banked for their best play.

edits.before: Steer the Q through the pair, E the trade-back, auto from the passive window — billed, healed, and re-saddled.
edits.after: Land Q through both targets, E the retaliation, then auto during the passive window for a fully healed trade.

edits.before: Lingering dismounted for one more auto — the cat on foot is the game's most honest kill.
edits.after: One extra auto while dismounted is how yuumi players die — remount before you take it.
